description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'NavigationLinkBlock' that creates a configurable navigation link block with form handling, validation, and access control logic.

classes.name: NavigationLinkBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for a navigation link block with configurable URL, title, and icon.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the block (title, uri, icon_class).

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the block, including URL, link text, and icon class fields.

methods.name: validateIconClassElement
methods.description: Validates the icon CSS class input to contain only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.

methods.name: validateUriElement
methods.description: Validates the URI input to ensure accessibility and proper format.

methods.name: getUserEnteredStringAsUri
methods.description: Converts user input into a URI scheme, supporting entity autocomplete, internal paths, and special tokens.

methods.name: getUriAsDisplayableString
methods.description: Converts a URI into a human-readable display string, handling internal, entity, and route schemes.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Saves the form input into the block's configuration.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the link block, including access checks and rendering logic.
